title.en: Chapter 9 — The Whistle in the Dark

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: وبأوضة الدكتور، شاف هولمز خزنة حديد كبيرة.
sentences.en: And in the doctor's room, Holmes saw a big iron safe.
He said: what is in it?
Helen said: papers.
He said: is there a cat in it?
She said: a cat?
No!

sentences.ar: وأشر لصحن حليب زغير فوق الخزنة.
sentences.en: And he pointed to a small saucer of milk on top of the safe.

sentences.ar: وعالطاولة، سوط جلد، طرفه ملفوف عقدة، زي الأنشوطة.
sentences.en: And on the table, a leather whip, its end tied in a loop, like a noose.
Holmes said: Watson, I have seen enough.
And more than enough.

sentences.ar: ووجهه كان قاسي، ما شفته هيك قبل.
sentences.en: And his face was hard, as I had never seen it.

sentences.ar: قال لهيلين: الليلة، لما يرجع الدكتور وينام، حطي ضو بشباك أوضة جوليا.
sentences.en: He told Helen: tonight, when the doctor returns and sleeps, put a lamp in the window of Julia's room.

sentences.ar: وروحي نامي بأوضتك القديمة، وقفلي الباب.
sentences.en: And go and sleep in your old room, and lock the door.

sentences.ar: وإحنا بنيجي من الفندق، وبنقعد بأوضة جوليا مكانك.
sentences.en: And we come from the inn, and sit in Julia's room in your place.

sentences.ar: قالت: إنت عارف كيف ماتت جوليا؟
sentences.en: She said: you know how Julia died?
He said: I believe so.
But I want to be sure.

sentences.ar: وبالفندق، قال لي: واطسون، في خطر حقيقي الليلة.
sentences.en: And at the inn, he said to me: Watson, there is real danger tonight.

sentences.ar: قلت: شفت شي ما شفته أنا؟
sentences.en: I said: did you see something I did not?
He said: I saw the same things.
But I drew conclusions.
A ventilator between two rooms.
A rope reaching the bed.
And a bed that cannot move.

sentences.ar: ودكتور عاش بالهند، وعنده حيوانات هندية.
sentences.en: And a doctor who lived in India, and keeps Indian animals.
At ten, we saw the lamp in the window.

sentences.ar: وطلعنا من الشباك، ودخلنا الأوضة، بلا صوت.
sentences.en: And we climbed in through the window, and entered the room, without a sound.
Holmes whispered: no light.
And no sleep.
Your life depends on staying awake.
And we sat in the dark.
An hour, two, three.
And the church clock striking every quarter.

sentences.ar: ومن الحديقة، صوت الفهد، وهو بيمشي.
sentences.en: And from the garden, the sound of the cheetah, pacing.
And at three, we saw a light in the ventilator.
And then the smell of burning oil.
Someone had lit a lantern in the other room.
And then a sound.

sentences.ar: صوت واطي، زي بخار بيطلع من غلاية.
sentences.en: A low sound, like steam from a kettle.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، هولمز نط، وشعل كبريتة، وصار يضرب بعصايته على حبل الجرس.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, Holmes leapt, struck a match, and began lashing with his cane at the bell-rope.
And he shouted: did you see it, Watson?
Did you see it?
I saw nothing.
But I heard a low whistle.

sentences.ar: ووجه هولمز كان أبيض، ومليان رعب واشمئزاز.
sentences.en: And Holmes's face was white, and full of horror and disgust.

sentences.ar: وبعدين، من الأوضة التانية، إجت صرخة.
sentences.en: And then, from the other room, came a scream.
A man's scream.
A scream they heard in the village, and woke to.
Holmes said: it is over.

sentences.ar: خد مسدسك، ورايحين على أوضة الدكتور.
sentences.en: Take your revolver, and we go to the doctor's room.

sentences.ar: كان الدكتور قاعد على كرسيه، والفانوس جنبه، والخزنة مفتوحة.
sentences.en: The doctor was sitting in his chair, the lantern beside him, the safe open.
His eyes open to the ceiling, and dead.
And around his head, a yellow speckled band.
Holmes said: the speckled band.
The deadliest snake in India.
He died in ten seconds.

sentences.ar: كان يبعتها من التهوية، على الحبل، عالسرير.
sentences.en: He would send it through the ventilator, down the rope, onto the bed.
And whistle for it to come back.
And the milk was its reward.

sentences.ar: وجوليا ماتت بلدغة ما حدا شافها.
sentences.en: And Julia died of a bite no one saw.
And Helen would have died tonight.

sentences.ar: بس ضربتي رجعتها من وين إجت، غضبانة، وعلى أول واحد لاقته.
sentences.en: But my blows drove it back where it came from, angry, and onto the first man it found.

sentences.ar: وقال هولمز: ما رح يثقل موته على ضميري كتير.
sentences.en: And Holmes said: his death will not weigh very heavily on my conscience.
